anabelen.serreno: On the way to S-F13, Hugo Serreno tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Hugo Serreno answered the first call, number 45 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Hugo Serreno caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Hugo Serreno helped stack spare sandbags at S-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Hugo Serreno and Clement Wanter argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
initial_dream8.6: Marek Dream joined the replacements on Day 4. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
